caseNameFull: Rhodes, Governor of Ohio v. Chapman

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 449 U. S. 951.] Motion of State Public Defender of California for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of the Attorney General of Oregon for leave to file an untimely motion for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.
